page_title: DOR 2-2 WER | Dortmund v Werder Bremen 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+5' Issa Kabore (Werder Bremen) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
90+5' A lofted cross from Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
90+4' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
90+3' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
90+1' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
87' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) sees a yellow card from Christian Dingert after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
87' It's time for a substitution. Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) comes on in place of Marvin Ducksch.
86' The linesman signals that Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
85' The shots on goal statistics – 2:3.
83' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
82' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
82' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
81' One of the players from Werder Bremen times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
79' Christian Dingert rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen).
77' Mike Tullberg has decided to substitute Julian Brandt and he is replaced by Waldemar Anton (Dortmund).
77' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
77' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
75' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
74' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) forces a pass into the box, but Gregor Kobel is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
72' 2 - 2 Goal! A great through ball by Jens Stage sets up Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the left side of the goal. 2:2.
71' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
70' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
68' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Gregor Kobel to dive and make a save.
67' PENALTY APPEAL by Werder Bremen, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

65' 2 - 1 Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) scores as he latches on to a pass and unleashes a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes into the top left corner of the goal and past the goalkeeper.
63' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) takes the corner which is cleared.
63' Christian Dingert shows a yellow card to Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) for his blatant foul.
61' Here is a change. Jamie Gittens is going off and Mike Tullberg gives the last tactical orders to Maximilian Beier (Dortmund).
61' Here comes a substitution. Julien Duranville (Dortmund) is brought on as a substitute for Karim Adeyemi.
60' The substitution is prepared. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marco Grull.
60' Substitution. Senne Lynen leaves the pitch and is replaced by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
60' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Issa Kabore (Werder Bremen) replacing Derrick Kohn.
59' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is flagged for offside.

59' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Michael Zetterer makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
58' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
56' Gregor Kobel leaps to intercept the corner kick from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen).
53' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Christian Dingert signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Dortmund players celebrate.
53' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Dortmund players aren’t happy.
51' 2 - 0 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. A slightly disorientated Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) puts the ball into his own net.
50' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
49' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
47' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' The whistle blows and Christian Dingert starts the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Dortmund are ruled offside.
45+5' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45+2' Gregor Kobel displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
45+1' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Dortmund was in an offside position.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
42' Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) commits a rough challenge and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for an infringement.
40' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
39' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
39' Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
37' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
36' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
35' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) commits a rough foul. Christian Dingert stops the game and makes a call.
34' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
34' An attempted cross from Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) is cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Werder Bremen are going to take it.
33' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) makes a slide tackle, but referee Christian Dingert blows for a foul.
32' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
32' The free kick is taken by Pascal Gross (Dortmund), but ball is cleared. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick.
31' It looks like Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) saw red with that tackle. Christian Dingert won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Dortmund have a free kick.
28' 1 - 0 Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) gets on the end of a delightful cross and powers a sweet header towards goal that goes in off the crossbar!
27' Dortmund are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
25' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
23' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes a shot from a mid-range free kick and the ball flies inches wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
21' We have witnessed a sending-off! Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) is given a red card for his dangerous challenge. Christian Dingert's decision is final.
20' The percentage of ball possession is – 65:35.
18' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a long ball in, but Michael Zetterer comfortably gathers the ball.
18' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

16' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Christian Dingert blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
13' The referee blows his whistle as Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) was too aggressive in his challenge.
12' Felix Nmecha is being substituted because of an injury. Mike Tullberg sends Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) on the pitch.
10' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) has tested the patience of referee Christian Dingert and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
10' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
8' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
4' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
4' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
2' Christian Dingert blows his whistle and it's Julian Brandt (Dortmund) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Werder Bremen will kick the game off.
Christian Dingert will supervise the game today.
